# Original synthetic public development documents

These 32 small PDFs were generated for this project from the versioned script
tools/evaluation/build_round2_complexity_assets.py. No customer data, downloaded
benchmark, personal information, model output or hidden-test content is used.
Project redistribution is permitted as MIT.

Thirty native-text originals use five layout families (six per family): prose,
two columns, ruled tables, sparse tables, and text/table/image mixtures. Two
image-only PDFs are explicit no-OCR boundary cases. Documents within each family
share generation rules and are not independent blind samples. All are prompt_dev;
there is no held-out claim. Distinct hashes do not imply independent templates.

The public scoring file contains expected page/quote checks used after parsing.
The predictor accepts PDF bytes only; it receives no IDs, family labels, expected
quotes, execution times or parser success outcomes. Page/character evidence maps
refer to normalized extracted text, not original PDF byte offsets or bounding boxes.

ReportLab core PDF fonts are used for native text. Image-only pages contain
original geometric shapes generated by Pillow without external fonts.
The generator uses ReportLab invariant metadata. The total corpus is small and is
not an OHR-Bench substitute or evidence of OCR/quality correction capability.
